fiscal.title: Fiscal documents
fiscal.lead: Fiscal documents registered with the tax channel, and the ones that need attention.
fiscal.notFound: This fiscal document does not exist in your legal entity.

breaks.title: Reconciliation breaks
breaks.body: Documents the channel has rejected or not yet registered.
breaks.empty: No breaks: every document is registered.
breaks.summaryOpen: {count, plural, =0 {No open breaks} one {# open break} other {# open breaks}}

stub.title: Stub channel
stub.body: These identifiers are synthetic and are not fiscal evidence.

placeholder.title: Placeholder document type
placeholder.body: The document type is a placeholder until the tax document types are settled; it is never sent to the real service.

actions.reasonHelp: Recorded in the audit trail (up to 500 characters).
actions.reasonInvalid: Enter a reason of up to 500 characters.

resubmit.title: Resubmit to the tax channel
resubmit.lead: Send this rejected document to the channel again. It is registered, or rejected again with new codes.

cancel.title: Cancel fiscal document
cancel.lead: Cancels this document. A registered document is cancelled with a linked cancellation document.
cancel.warn: A cancelled document stays on record and cannot be registered again.

correct.title: Correct fiscal document
correct.lead: Issues a credit note for this document and a corrected replacement with the amounts below. The corrected total must stay consistent with the source.
correct.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with up to four decimals.

bulk.title: Resubmit rejected documents
bulk.lead: Select rejected documents to send again (at most {limit}). Each one is answered separately.
bulk.none: No rejected documents on this list.

qr.title: QR payload
qr.body: The data printed as the QR code on the document.
qr.unverified: The QR layout has not been verified against the tax authority specification. Do not print it on customer documents.
qr.none: The channel has not produced a QR payload yet.

breaksPage.title: Reconciliation breaks
breaksPage.lead: Local fiscal documents whose books and the tax channel status disagree. A break closes by itself when a later run no longer finds it.

run.title: Run reconciliation
run.lead: Compare the legal entity's fiscal documents with the channel status and record the breaks. Safe to repeat: breaks are never duplicated.

list.title: Breaks
list.empty: No breaks here: every document agrees with the channel.
